----------------------------------------------------------------------
 Office Notes, Office Memoranda of Coram, Co
 appearances, Court's orders of directions
 and Registrar's orders
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 Mr. T. M. Malnas, Advocate for Applicants.
 Mr. Amit Chutke, A.P.P. for Non-applicant/Stat
 Coram : Vinay Joshi And Mrs.Vrushali V. Joshi,
Dated : 15/03/2024.
. Heard.

2. This is an application seeking to quash First Information Report in Crime No.801/2023 registered with Police Station Digras, District Yavatmal for the offence punishable under Section 498A read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. It is the applicant's submission that they are distant relatives of the husband, however, falsely implicated.

4. Issue notice to the non-applicants, returnable on 29.04.2024.
5.
Learned A.P.P. waives service of notice of non- applicant/State.
6. In the meantime, investigation may go on, but charge-sheet shall not be filed without obtaining leave of this Court.

(MRS. VRUSHALI V. JOSHI, J.) (VINAY JOSHI, J.) RGurnule Signed by: Mrs. R.M. MANDADE Designation: PA To Honourable Judge Date: 15/03/2024 17:41:58 Jabin W/O Afsar Khan And Another vs The State Of Mah. Thr. Pso Ps Digras ... on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65474793/
